summary: Implemented bounded live flashlight intensity control from gamepad triggers in examples/flashlight/run.py, with focused unit coverage and a short docs update for live teleop controls.
work_completed: Added default left/right trigger analog handling: Gamepad_LeftTriggerAxis decreases intensity and Gamepad_RightTriggerAxis increases intensity.
Added runtime intensity update logic that calls SetIntensity on the existing live SpotLightComponent without rebuilding or restarting the scene.
Added clamped CLI controls for intensity rate/min/max, trigger deadzone, trigger key names, and throttled intensity logging while preserving existing defaults.
Updated live flashlight teleop documentation to mention trigger controls and intensity clamp override flags.
Added focused tests for default CLI values, right-trigger increase, left-trigger decrease/clamping, and runtime application to an existing fake light component.
Ran python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation successfully: 93 tests passed.

findings.message: Live runtime validation in an actual display/gamepad session was not performed; verification was limited to unit tests in the repository environment.

follow_up_recommendations: Run the realistic live cafeteria command in a display-capable session with a gamepad to tune the default trigger rate/deadzone if operator feel needs adjustment.
memory_worthy: Live flashlight teleop now supports bounded analog trigger intensity adjustment on the existing SpotLightComponent via --intensity-adjust-rate, --intensity-min, --intensity-max, and trigger/deadzone flags.
